% Linear Alfvén wave BVP in isothermal stratified atmosphere
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_ode}
V''(y) + k^2(y)\,V(y) = 0,\qquad k(y) = \omega/v_A(y) = k_0\,e^{-y/(2H)},\qquad k_0 = \omega\sqrt{\rho_0}/B_{y0}
\end{equation}

% Substitution $\xi = 2H k(y)$ reduces to Bessel of order 0
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_bessel}
\xi^2 U_{\xi\xi} + \xi U_\xi + \xi^2 U = 0\quad\Longrightarrow\quad U(\xi) = c_1 J_0(\xi) + c_2 Y_0(\xi)
\end{equation}

% Outgoing branch under §E3 top absorbing BC
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_hankel}
V(y) = v_x^{\mathrm{drv}}\cdot \frac{H_0^{(2)}(\xi(y))}{H_0^{(2)}(\xi_0)},\qquad H_0^{(2)} = J_0 - i Y_0
\end{equation}

% Exact steady-state amplitude ratio (Bessel-function benchmark)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_R_exact}
R_{\mathrm{exact}}(y_1, y_2) = \frac{\lvert H_0^{(2)}(\xi(y_2))\rvert}{\lvert H_0^{(2)}(\xi(y_1))\rvert} = \sqrt{\frac{J_0^2(\xi_2)+Y_0^2(\xi_2)}{J_0^2(\xi_1)+Y_0^2(\xi_1)}}
\end{equation}

% Leading WKB (large-$\xi$ asymptotic)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_R_WKB}
R_{\mathrm{WKB}}(y_1, y_2) = \sqrt{\xi_1/\xi_2} = e^{(y_2 - y_1)/(4H)} = \bigl(\rho(y_1)/\rho(y_2)\bigr)^{1/4}
\end{equation}

% T7 numerical benchmark values (H=1, f=2, B_{y0}=0.5, y1=0.5, y2=1.5)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:E3_audit_numbers}
R_{\mathrm{WKB}} = 1.284025,\qquad R_{\mathrm{exact}} = 1.283935
